I identified the target as the paired black wall-wash/exit-style light fixture symbol. In the drawing, these appear as small pairs of black fixture marks near the following locations:

- Right wall near (1414, 195): a pair of small black triangles at about (1414, 190) and (1414, 203). This reads as one instance.
- Left wall near (71, 545): a pair at about (71, 540) and (71, 553). This reads as one instance.
- Lower right near (1150, 653): a pair at about (1150, 655). This reads as one instance.
- Bottom right near (1365, 815): a pair at about (1365, 815). This reads as one instance.
- Bottom near (1088, 825): a pair at about (1088, 825). This reads as one instance.
- Lower center right near (1277, 653): a pair at about (1277, 653). This reads as one instance.

These identifications are based on small shapes that I could not inspect closely, so some may be wrong.
